release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.1.1

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe and the matching _internal folder. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe. It does not remove folders already next to the program, so the LibreOffice folder stays and Office files still convert. This zip does not include LibreOffice. Tesseract and Labels are inside the program folder.

Mail Merge at 90° or 270° swings from the top-left corner stored in X and Y. That corner stays where you put it. The outline on the template matches the printed field. Left, Center, and Right run along the length of the turned field. At 180° the field stays in place and the words turn upside down.

A missing Image or PDF in a mail-merge field stops the merge and says File not found, with the path from the spreadsheet. The monitor does not call that an engine crash.

When LockStepPDF starts, it checks for a newer hot-fix. A dialog appears only when a newer one is available.

After the trial, OCR stays available. Labels locks with the other Pro tools.
